one_liner: Higgsfield has a self-serve REST API (api.higgsfield.ai) for 50+ image/video models using a key ID:secret, funded by a prepaid USD balance ($5 min top-up), plus an official OAuth MCP server that uses plan credits.
auth_notes: REST API: key ID + secret sent as `Authorization: Key KEY_ID:SECRET`, generated in the console at open.higgsfield.ai. OAuth (with Dynamic Client Registration) applies only to the MCP server, which acts on the user's higgsfield.ai account; the REST API has no documented OAuth.
access_notes: The API requires a funded prepaid USD balance (minimum top-up $5). No free tier is documented. The website plan is a separate product and doesn't grant API access. The MCP route requires an active paid subscription.
blocker_notes: Must register a payment method and fund the balance (min $5) before the API can be used. Otherwise self-serve and documented.
